sources.title: Co-Intelligence: How to Live and Work with AI
sources.quote_checked: Treat it like a person and you're 90% of the way there. | My argument has always been to use it for everything, and that's how you figure what it's good or bad at.

sources.title: A Wharton professor says AI is like an 'intern' who 'lies a little bit' to make their bosses happy
Why one expert says AI is like the world's greatest intern
sources.quote_checked: You have to think of it like an intern. | Unlike a person, the AI never gets discouraged

sources.title: MBA Professor Of The Year: Wharton's Ethan Mollick
sources.quote_checked: Working with AI is a dialogue, not an order. | The first rule in my book is to spend ten hours doing the work and you will figure it out. | AI is not Google and does not provide consistent or even reliable answers. | nobody actually knows the future of AI
